messages:
alex_k: Heads-up — Sparrow (customer) is targeting a private rollout next week. Need quick sync on networking + air-gap blockers. Who's owning the egress fallback and cert distribution?
maya_s: I can own cert distribution (PKI + CSR flow). Will need the final SAN list by EOD Thu. :white_check_mark:
ben_prodeng: Egress fallback is currently assigned to me but flagging that our egress prober still fails for 10.2.1 image behind their NAT. Sam, can you confirm prober logs?
tori_net: Re: NAT — Sparrow uses 1:many PAT on their outbound. We should confirm our healthcheck uses source-port-agnostic probing. Also need their proxy ACL for image registry.
sam_oncall: Prober output: ``ERROR: connection reset by peer`` when streaming kv-cache warmup. I dumped /var/log/redwood/prober.log and attached in the ticket. Might be PMTU or TCP RST from their middlebox.
alex_k: Thanks. Ben, can you open a quick PR that switches prober to use CONNECT w/ keepalive so it survives NAT? Ping me for review.
ben_prodeng: On it — drafting branch `prober/nat-stable`. Will add feature flag `--nat-friendly-probe`. ETA today.
maya_s: For certs, Sparrow said they rotate CAs monthly. We should document our CSR renewal and owner (maya_s) in the cutover notes. Also need to confirm HSM/KMS integration for private.
tori_net: Firewall ask from their team: allow outbound to registry.redwood.ai:443, metrics.redwood.ai:443, and control-plane on 10.8.0.0/22 -> our mgmt IPs. Also inbound only from their jumpbox on 203.0.113.12:22 for debugging. They requested a diagram and minimal ports.
alex_k: I'll draft the diagram and post in the ticket. Ben — any dependency on the runtime image digest changing after quantization? That affects firewall whitelist if they pin digests.
ben_prodeng: Good call — our quant pipeline will change digests for q8_0 builds. We need to give Sparrow static image tags (e.g., redwood/runtime:stable-2026-03-12) and advise them not to pin SHAs unless they accept updates. I'll add note to deploy README.
sam_oncall: Small oncall ask: if we flip fallback to hosted, we need an automatic rollback hook if latency > 500ms for 5m. I can wire the alert if ops agrees.
maya_s: CSR list requested: `api.redwood.sparrow`, `control.redwood.sparrow`, plus their jumpbox CN. I pulled details from the onboarding form — will drop a YAML snippet in the ticket.
ben_prodeng: PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/prodeng/prober/pulls/82 (feature flag + tests). @alex_k review requested.
alex_k: Reviewing now. Leaving minor nits. Otherwise LGTM. Will merge once tests are green.
tori_net: One more: they are air-gapped for images but allow egress to a signed-repo proxy. We need to provide verified image archive + sha256 checksums. I'll coordinate with supply-chain to generate SBOM per image.
alex_k: Ownership matrix for roll: certs -> maya_s, egress/prober -> ben_prodeng, network firewall diagram -> tori_net, rollback and alerts -> sam_oncall. Posting final checklist in #eng-platform by EOD. :calendar:
deploy-bot: CI passed on prodeng/prober#82 — all tests green.
ben_prodeng: Merged and deployed to staging. Can someone run a quick staging smoke against Sparrow's staging VPC tomorrow 09:00 PT?
maya_s: 09:00 PT works for me. I'll be on for cert handoff.
sam_oncall: I can run the prober and watch logs during the window.
alex_k: Great — I'll coordinate with Sparrow PM for the 09:00 handoff and confirm their jumpbox is ready. If anything blocks, we'll escalate to oncall.
maya_s: Final ask — Sparrow needs an emergency rollback playbook in plain steps (3 bullets). Can we author that in the ticket?
ben_prodeng: I'll write a 3-step rollback: disable routing to private cluster, flip to hosted fallback, and rotate secrets if needed. Will attach to ticket after staging smoke.
alex_k: Perfect. Thanks team.
